nodes.name: power_boost_9v
nodes.description: MT3608 boost converter generates VCC_9V from USB_5V for NE5532 preamplifier. EN pin tied to VIN for always-on operation. FB pin connects to feedback divider network to set 9V output. SW pin is the switching node. This module provides isolated analog power rail separate from digital 3.3V domain.

nodes.description: Power switch output, drain of internal MOSFET, connects to inductor and output rectifier, swings between GND and 28V

nodes.name: EN

nodes.name: VIN
nodes.description: Input supply pin, operating range 2V-24V, must be locally bypassed with capacitor

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps USB_5V down to VCC_3V3 for ATmega328P and MCP4725. This is the digital and mixed-signal power domain. Input and output need bypass capacitors. This module is the VCC_3V3 distribution hub.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P AVR MCU operating at 3.3V. I2C master on PC4 (SDA) and PC5 (SCL) to control MCP4725 DAC. PC4 and PC5 require external pull-up resistors to VCC_3V3. MCU generates digital control signals; no crystal specified, internal RC oscillator assumed. BOOT behavior not configurable via exposed pins per component data.

nodes.name: dac_control
nodes.description: MCP4725 12-bit I2C DAC receives digital commands from ATmega328P and outputs analog GAIN_CTRL signal. A0 pin tied to GND or VCC to set I2C address (single device on bus, address bit configurable). VOUT provides shared bias/gain control voltage to NE5532 preamp. I2C pull-ups owned by MCU module.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: preamp_stereo
nodes.description: NE5532 dual low-noise op-amp powered from VCC_9V (positive rail) and GND (negative rail, single-supply operation). Two independent channels for left and right stereo paths. IN1_P/IN2_P are non-inverting inputs, IN1_N/IN2_N are inverting inputs for feedback networks. GAIN_CTRL from MCP4725 feeds bias/gain control network for both channels. OUT1 and OUT2 drive PAM8403 amplifier inputs. Star-ground connection to system GND with analog domain separation.

nodes.name: power_amp
nodes.description: PAM8403 3W stereo Class-D amplifier powered directly from USB_5V. VDD and PVDD_1/PVDD_2 connect to 5V rail. INL and INR receive left/right signals from NE5532 preamp. OUT_L_P/OUT_L_N and OUT_R_P/OUT_R_N drive external stereo speakers. MUTE and SHDN pins need pull-up/down configuration for normal operation (active low typically). VREF is internal reference bypass. PGND_1/PGND_2 are power grounds tied to system GND. Class-D switching requires careful layout near speaker outputs.
